task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the NASDAQ market is open, then get the current BTC price and the USD-to-EUR exchange rate. After that, check the balance status of my checking account for user_01, send me a high-priority in-app balance report titled “Balance Report” in USD, and then place an AAPL equity order using my risk token at a limit price of 185.5.

Finally, place an AAPL equity order using my risk token risk_tok_abc123 at a limit price of 185.5.
